notes.title: Nobody Nowhere is Now Available! (Cloud Save Temporarily Disabled)
notes.content:
[h1]Thank you for your patience! Nobody Nowhere is now live and ready to play—welcome![/h1]

[list]
[*] With a linear plot and a single ending, it takes about 3 hours to complete. 
[/list]
[list]
[*] There are no restrictions on live streaming or recording, so feel free to share and discuss your experience with others!
[/list]

[h3]Important Notes:[/h3]
[b]Cloud Save: [/b]Since the game is relatively short, Steam Cloud saves are temporarily disabled, so your progress won't carry over if you switch devices.

[b]Steam Deck Compatibility:[/b]The game has been tested on Steam Deck, but due to issues like lagging and audio-video sync problems during the ending song, we do not recommend playing on Steam Deck.

[h3]Bug Report:[/h3]
If you encounter any bugs while playing, please reach out to us!

[b]Bug report via QQ group: ：[/b]809436637
[b]Discord:[/b][url=https://discord.gg/KtzFkwwdVW]Nobody Nowhere[/url]

Thank you for your continued support!

notes.title: Nobody Nowhere Launching Tomorrow—Feb 17, 2025!
notes.content:
[h3]Nobody Nowhere will be launched tomorrow, which is Feb 17, 2025![/h3]
Thank you for your patience! The official version is finally here and ready to meet you.

[b]About the Game:[/b]
[list]
[*] With about 3 hours of gameplay,Nobody Nowhere features 50+ maps, 130+ character illustrations, and 260+ pixel animations, all designed to immerse you in the story.
[/list]
[list]
[*] Please note that Steam Cloud and Steam Deck support are temporarily disabled.
[/list]

[b]Join the discussion in our official channel:[/b]
QQ Group: 923500627
Discord：[url=https://discord.gg/KtzFkwwdVW]Nobody Nowhere[/url]

Lastly, enjoy the countdown to Nobody Nowhere's release with our special celebratory images!
